args.intent: customer lifetime value total spend per customer

args.sql:
SELECT AVG(customer_total) AS avg_ltv_usd
FROM (
  SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(o.amount - o.discount) / 100.0 AS customer_total
  FROM memory.bench.orders o
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
) t

SELECT AVG(COALESCE(t.customer_total,0)) AS avg_ltv_usd, COUNT(*) AS active_customers
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM memory.bench.orders) ac
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount - discount) / 100.0 AS customer_total
  FROM memory.bench.orders
  WHERE status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t ON ac.customer_id = t.customer_id
